concepts.name: Meaning of Indian Economy
concepts.description: The Indian economy refers to the system through which India produces, distributes, and consumes goods and services. It is a mixed economy where both the public and private sectors contribute to economic development.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to describe the nature and structure of the Indian economy.

concepts.name: Characteristics of the Indian Economy
concepts.description: The Indian economy is characterized by a large population, mixed economic structure, regional diversity, and a growing service sector alongside agriculture and industry.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify the major characteristics of the Indian economy.

concepts.name: Economic Development
concepts.description: Economic development involves improvements in income, employment, infrastructure, education, healthcare, and the overall standard of living of people.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the concept of economic development using suitable indicators.

concepts.name: Primary Sector
concepts.description: The primary sector includes agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining, and other activities that directly utilize natural resources.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify activities belonging to the primary sector.

concepts.name: Secondary Sector
concepts.description: The secondary sector consists of manufacturing, construction, and industries that convert raw materials into finished products.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the role of the secondary sector in economic growth.

concepts.name: Tertiary Sector
concepts.description: The tertiary or service sector includes banking, transportation, communication, healthcare, education, tourism, and information technology services.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to classify service-based activities under the tertiary sector.

concepts.name: Poverty
concepts.description: Poverty refers to the inability of individuals or households to meet their basic needs such as food, clothing, housing, education, and healthcare.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the causes and effects of poverty in India.

concepts.name: Unemployment
concepts.description: Unemployment occurs when people who are willing and able to work cannot find suitable employment opportunities.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify different forms of unemployment and their impact on the economy.

concepts.name: Population Growth
concepts.description: Rapid population growth increases the demand for employment, education, healthcare, housing, and other essential resources.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to analyze the economic effects of population growth.

concepts.name: Agriculture in India
concepts.description: Agriculture remains an important source of employment, food security, and raw materials for industries despite the growth of other sectors.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the importance of agriculture in the Indian economy.

concepts.name: Industrial Development
concepts.description: Industrial development increases production, creates employment opportunities, promotes exports, and contributes to economic modernization.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the contribution of industries to India's economic development.

concepts.name: Growth of the Service Sector
concepts.description: The service sector has become the largest contributor to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP), supported by information technology, finance, education, healthcare, and tourism.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to describe the growing importance of the service sector in India.

concepts.name: Development Planning
concepts.description: The government formulates economic policies and development programs to promote inclusive growth, employment, infrastructure, and social welfare.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the role of government planning in economic development.

concepts.name: Inclusive Growth
concepts.description: Inclusive growth aims to ensure that the benefits of economic development reach all sections of society, including disadvantaged groups.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the concept and importance of inclusive growth.

concepts.name: Sustainable Development
concepts.description: Sustainable development promotes economic progress while conserving natural resources and protecting the environment for future generations.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain the importance of sustainable development in the Indian economy.

concepts.name: Understanding the Indian Economy
concepts.description: This chapter introduces the structure, sectors, challenges, and development of the Indian economy while highlighting the government's role in promoting inclusive and sustainable growth.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to analyze the structure and major challenges of the Indian economy and explain the contribution of different sectors to national development.
